scenes.narration: The truth is, there is neither happiness nor unhappiness in this world.

scenes.narration: There is only the comparison of one state with another.

scenes.narration: Only a man who has felt ultimate despair is capable of feeling ultimate bliss.

scenes.narration: It is necessary to have wished for death in order to know how good it is to live.

scenes.narration: The sum of all human wisdom is contained in these two words: wait and hope.
